# VOCAL spectrum display mode

The player spectrum analyzer now has NORMAL and VOCAL display modes. VOCAL is the default and is persisted in player_visualizer preferences. It applies display-only logarithmic frequency weighting to the existing 48 spectrum bands, emphasizing approximately 300 Hz to 4 kHz and reducing sub-bass and extreme treble motion. Playback PCM, DSP, encoding, metadata, and cover processing are unchanged. Waveform mode remains unweighted.
